cases.title: Descriptor digests are equal in both modes
cases.when: The vector tools run standalone and as a governed package
then: server/discover _meta io.ololabs.toolgate/descriptorDigests equals the packaged digests

cases.title: Every example gives the same result in both modes
cases.when: Every Example and shared fixture runs in both modes with the same inputs
then: Outputs, error codes, and route calls (route id and variables) are equal

cases.title: Timeout after send behaves the same
cases.when: A ledger tool's upstream accepts the request and never answers, in both modes
then: Both end OUTCOME_UNKNOWN with effectUncertain true; neither retries

cases.title: Connection reset behaves the same
cases.when: The upstream resets the connection before and after the request is sent
then: Same error codes and effect flags in both modes

cases.title: Upstream 5xx behaves the same
cases.when: The upstream returns 503 for an IDEMPOTENT and a NON_IDEMPOTENT tool
then: Same retries (only IDEMPOTENT) and same final error in both modes

cases.title: No API exists in only one mode
cases.when: The public API surface is diffed between the standalone and governed runtimes
then: Identical; capabilities a runtime cannot honour fail with CLIENT_TOOLS_UNAVAILABLE, CLAIMS_UNAVAILABLE or CONFIGURATION, never with empty data

cases.title: Governed mode adds no route, secret, claim, destination or weaker effect
cases.when: The governed package descriptor is compared with the standalone declarations
then: No addition and no weaker effect class

cases.title: Undeclared routes are refused in both modes
cases.when: Tool code calls an undeclared route in both modes
then: Standalone: the SDK client refuses it

cases.title: Business-key outcomes match
cases.when: The same key sequence (new, repeat, conflict) runs against SQLite standalone and Control governed

cases.title: Task behaviour matches
cases.when: An async tool runs with progress, input and cancel in both modes
